item.description:
• "Move to Homebrew" and "Upgrade" stay available after a run finishes: the summary screen is no longer a dead end, and failed or skipped apps can be selected again and retried right from it
  • Installing `mas` from the banner now shows progress and the banner disappears once it's installed, without restarting Kegwatch. If the install fails, the reason is shown
  • When an upgrade fails, the full reason is now shown wrapped under the app's row instead of being cut off
  • The glass window background is now tinted, so a bright window behind Kegwatch no longer washes it out and makes text hard to read
  • The menu bar badge now also counts updates for apps that aren't selected for upgrade
